name: Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go

podcast.body: In 1984, determined to break into the US market, Wham! leader George Michael employed the "old British invasion trick of selling America back to the Americans." This song was a "shameless send up of 50s sock hop and 60s Motown" and reached number one on the Hot 100 by November 1984. "Wake me up before you go go was a shameless send up of 50s sock hop and 60s Motown. And it got WAM to number one on the Hot 100 by November 84."
